map.理想气体体积（V = nRT / P） 使用指南: Ideal Gas Volume (V = nRT / P) User Guide
map.根据理想气体状态方程 PV = nRT 计算在给定压强、温度、物质的量下的气体体: Compute the gas volume at a given pressure, temperature and amount of substance from the ideal gas law PV = nRT.
map.标况体积验证：1 mol 气体 0°C、1 atm 约 22.4 L，校验计量关: Standard condition volume check: 1 mol of gas at 0°C and 1 atm is about 22.4 L, verifying the measurement relationship.
map.工况体积换算：由 n 与 P/T 算实际体积，指导容器选型。: Working volume conversion: compute the actual volume from n and P/T to guide container selection.
map.产气量估算：由反应摩尔数算生成气体体积，评估排气/收集量。: Gas yield estimation: compute the volume of gas generated from the number of moles reacted, to assess venting or collection volume.

map.标况为什么是 22.4 L？: Why is the volume at standard conditions 22.4 L?
map.0°C(273K)、1 atm 下 1 mol 理想气体，由 V=nRT/P 直: At 0°C (273 K) and 1 atm, 1 mol of ideal gas gives V directly from V = nRT/P.
map.压强升高体积怎么变？: How does the volume change when the pressure rises?
map.同 nT 下 V 与 P 成反比，增压体积缩小。: At the same n and T, V is inversely proportional to P; raising the pressure shrinks the volume.
map.低压高温近似好，高压需压缩因子 Z 修正。: The approximation is good at low pressure and high temperature; at high pressure a compressibility factor Z correction is needed.
